deadline.value: Apply by April 1, 2027 as a non-Canadian applicant for September entry (Canadians June 1). Funding is considered with the admission application.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: The department encourages you to contact potential supervisors before you start; the Graduate Studies Committee reviews applications.
supervisor.quote: Before you begin your studies at Dalhousie, we encourage you to visit the department or start an email correspondence with faculty members whose research interests you.

funding.value: Full-time students are supported by supervisors' research awards plus paid teaching in undergraduate labs, normally for four years in the PhD.
funding.quote: The Chemistry Program considers financial support for students at the same time as admission. | We support full-time graduate students by research awards from their supervisors and by remuneration for teaching in undergraduate laboratories. | Normally, that is two years for MSc students, and four years for PhD students.

entry_route.value: Most PhD entrants hold a master's, but you can enter from a BSc (with more coursework) or transfer from the MSc.
entry_route.quote: PhD degree candidates proceeding from a BSc degree require a minimum of four one-term courses at the graduate level

also.quote: Most candidates for admission to a doctoral program possess a Master's Degree. Direct entry to some programs is possible for those with exceptional academic standing

notes: MSc students can transfer to the PhD without finishing the MSc. PhD Qualifying Report within 18 months.
